problem.md: The package README was technically complete but led with dense implementation detail. It did not give prospective npm users an immediate value proposition, a short copy-paste workflow, a command map, or clear open-source trust signals.

goal.md: Make the npm-facing README a concise open-source landing page: explain Iris in one sentence, show the local workflow visually, provide verified installation and command examples, link contribution and security policies, and improve npm discovery metadata without overstating unsupported export capabilities.

hld.md:
The repository README is packed by npm and rendered on the package page. Package metadata improves search and discovery after the next release.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  repo["Repository README"]:::svc
  npm[("npm package tarball")]:::db
  page["npm package page"]:::focus
  repo --> npm --> page
```

lld.md:
The documentation update uses only facts verified from the installed CLI and package metadata.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant Maintainer
  participant README
  participant Package as package.json
  participant npm
  Maintainer->>README: update npm-facing content
  Maintainer->>Package: refine description and keywords
  Package-->>npm: publish next release
  README-->>npm: render package page
```

tasks.title: Design and verify the npm-facing README and package discovery metadata
